snippet.title: Random Innards Bits, Slices of Hyperbolic Gaming
snippet.description:
Just some quick fun to announce I'm back on the saddle. Can't escape the hyper kink

Innards is an action-adventure game set in hyperbolic geometry. Free demo: https://cancrizans.itch.io/innards

btw: this video uses the "Radio" hyperbolic projection (azimuthal equidistant), which, now that most bugs with it are being straightened out (forgive the pun), is proving to be my favorite projection for playing... it has the least amount of nausea. Considering making it the default.
